title: Newsroom
content: CII uses cookies to improve your website & conference experiences, including enhancing website navigation, personalized features & promotions, evaluating our services, and customizing content and ads based on your preferences as you browse or engage with us. By clicking "Continue" or continuing to use our site, you are agreeing to our and our partners use of cookies. See our Privacy Policy for more information. Welcome to the Bio-IT World's Online Newsroom, your resource for press releases, news coverage, and more. Members of the press looking to cover Bio-IT World are invited to apply for a press pass here .
